# Test data generated by MATLAB R2026a (2026-10-19)

All files here were produced by running MATLAB on an unmodified copy of `reference/matlab/model.m`
(only `clear; clc; close all;` replaced by `set(0,"DefaultFigureVisible","off");`, saved as `runmodel.m`).
- `matlab_S01/`: `matlab_scripts/export_baseline.m` (baseline model.m).
- `matlab_S02/`: same script with `slope_value = 10;` (model.asv value) in `runmodel.m`.
- `ml_values.txt`: `matlab_scripts/dumpvals.m` (F_x_max, summary values, pchip samples incl. off-grid points).
  Its `colon ...` line is a leftover of a failed first attempt and is ignored by the tests.
- `ml_colon.txt`: `matlab_scripts/colons.m` (exact output of MATLAB colon `a:-d:b` and some ascending ranges).
Run e.g. `matlab -batch "cd('<dir>'); export_baseline" < /dev/null > log.txt 2>&1` with `runmodel.m` in `<dir>`.
